metadata.name: JuiConfig
metadata.description: Single-page reference for every key the toolchain reads from jui.config.json: core directories, platforms.*, build.normalizeLayouts, api.*, test.*, checks[] + databases{}, and lint.*. Collects what was previously scattered across the pages that use each key. Content is hand-maintained against jui_tools ConfigManager and each key's consumer.

uiVariables.description: Bottom next-read cards (CLI command reference, DB schema check).
